questions.evidence: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord

questions.q: Of the sinners Christ came to save, what does Paul call himself?
questions.evidence: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief

questions.q: What should no one despise in Timothy?
questions.evidence: Let no man despise your youth

questions.q: What does Paul tell Timothy to use for his stomach's sake?
questions.evidence: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities

questions.q: What is a root of all kinds of evil?
questions.evidence: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil
